title: Property-test tk's merge drivers with Hegel
description:
Operator, 2026-09-27: trial property-based testing (Hegel, https://hegel.dev, Go library hegel.dev/go/hegel, beta; loads the Rust libhegel at run time, no cgo) on tk's merge drivers, which had a real data-loss bug (ticfac 8lg: merge-file wrote the result to the wrong path).

tk merge-file (three-way merge of a tick JSON), properties over generated base/ours/theirs ticks:
- a field changed on one side only survives the merge
- merging with an unchanged side returns the other side exactly
- merge(base, x, x) == x
- no key is lost, including keys this tk does not model (n26 - write that property even if it fails today, and mark it)
- the result is written to %A (git's contract)
tk merge-activity (union merge of JSONL): no line is dropped or duplicated; order is deterministic.

Wire libhegel into CI (git-lfs vendored copy or HEGEL_LIBHEGEL_PATH). Report whether the tests found anything: that decides whether PBT spreads further.
acceptance_criteria: Hegel property tests for merge-file and merge-activity run in go test and in CI; any property that fails today is either fixed or recorded against its tick (e.g. n26) with the minimal counterexample; the report says what PBT found
